title: Ashen Delta: The Sentinel's Tide Ledger
premise: In a marsh where glass reeds record vanished flood levels, the sentinel must escort witnesses through guarded crossings using a oath-bound signal shield.
ending: Recover the Tide Ledger and return with the civilian refuge record; Delta Ferrymen can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive silt lightning while evading the drowned warden without sacrificing the civilian refuge record.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Delta Ferrymen to witness the oath-bound signal shield.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to stand guard or pursue the artifact
